title: EXPO / City Pavilion
backend: WebGPU (BrowserWebGpu); explicit unsupported-browser screen, no WebGL fallback
techniques: Furnished procedural pavilion and surrounding 32-building city
Articulated crowds following obstacle-aware aisle graph; Dijkstra destination routes
Day/night shadowed lighting, HDR bloom, illuminated windows and moving traffic
limitations: CPU-driven crowd; no pairwise pedestrian collision avoidance
HTML labels projected from Bevy world coordinates
Directional shadows; nine point lights do not cast shadows
Wall-frame RAF timing only, no GPU timestamps
Fixed native resolution does not reduce quality under load; manual/adaptive recovery opt-in

defaultResolution.backingFormula: round(CSS width * devicePixelRatio) × round(CSS height * devicePixelRatio)

testSummary: PASS: isolated Chrome, 1440x960 CSS viewport at DPR 2, actual 2880x1920 backing at 120 and 1200 walkers, fixed 100%, adaptive OFF. Backing unchanged during CPU stress. Manual 50%=1440x960. Resize 1200x800 at DPR2=>2400x1600; live DPR1.5=>2160x1440. Day/night, overhead/orbit/pan/zoom/reset, animated walking, booth/facility routes avoiding footprints, projected-label and CSS floor picking, cutaway, pause and recovery passed. Original scene preserved and also verified 2880x1920 at max load. Zero engine/browser errors and failed requests. Day/night/max/detail screenshots inspected. Unsupported-WebGPU explanations passed for both scenes. Public query HTML and gzip WASM HTTP 200. Automated browsers closed.
